mapper.sql: SELECT d.deposit_id, d.project_id, d.bid_no, d.project_name, d.deposit_type, d.pay_type, d.amount, d.pay_time, d.expect_refund_time, d.actual_refund_time, d.refund_status, d.voucher_url, d.dept_id, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark FROM bid_deposit d
mapper.select: WHERE d.project_id = #{projectId} AND d.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY d.deposit_id DESC
WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.refund_status = '0' AND d.expect_refund_time IS NOT NULL AND d.expect_refund_time < sysdate()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_deposit (project_id, bid_no, project_name, deposit_type, pay_type, amount, pay_time, expect_refund_time, actual_refund_time, refund_status, voucher_url, dept_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{bidNo}, #{projectName}, #{depositType}, #{payType}, #{amount}, #{payTime}, #{expectRefundTime}, #{actualRefundTime}, #{refundStatus}, #{voucherUrl}, #{deptId}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE bid_deposit SET del_flag = '2' WHERE deposit_id IN #{depositId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS "outCount", COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS "outAmount" FROM bid_deposit d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.refund_status = '0'
